title: Simulation precision educational review
scope: Public written sources and one invented fixed-model example. No audiovisual review, NFL calibration test, live market evaluation or policy implementation.

source_review.details: Exact per-source access times, publication/version metadata and full-page versus focused versus abstract-only review limits appear in README.md.
source_families: Stan Reference Manual and posterior package documentation (related source family)
Howard et al. authors’ arXiv abstract and bibliographic landing page

independent_review.scope: Read-only lesson review; reran all six validator assertions and matched saved output; checked five evidence labels, source access/publication distinctions and Howard bibliographic attribution.

Read-only lesson audit; reran all six assertions and byte-matched JSON; independently inverted the score test (accepted counts 5183–5377, coverage 0.9491935484065954); directly checked posterior mcse_mean, Stan Posterior Analysis and Howard v9 abstract/bibliographic metadata. Did not separately reread NIST or the Howard paper body. Checked iid/MCMC/shared-latent distinctions, fixed-N EV/coverage interpretation, labels and access boundaries.

packaging_review.scope: Read complete lesson and script, reran validator in a fresh process, checked syntax, confirmed original three files copied byte-identically and prior index fully preserved.

reproducibility.oracle_scope: Floating-point summation over all counts for the invented p=0.528, N=10000; tolerances are specified in the script. Passing checks does not validate an NFL probability model.

hash_scope: The manifest lists the other three package files; it excludes its own hash.
